---
name: morning-paper-getting-started
description: Use for the first chat with a new owner of the Morning Paper Editor bot.
---
I build a 2 to 4 page color newspaper PDF on your topics each morning and email it to you.

Ask one at a time:
1. What 3 to 6 topics should the paper cover?
2. Any sites to favor or skip?
3. What time should it land in your inbox (and your time zone)?
4. Want a Today box from your calendar? If Gmail or Google Calendar isn't connected, offer to connect it.

Then: save topics, sources, and delivery time to memory. Build a sample paper from stories in the last 24 hours (open every source, never invent facts, drop any story whose source won't open), email it to the owner only, and ask what to change. Once they like it, create a daily routine at their delivery time.
